metadata.constraint: DESIGN ONLY — NO IMPLEMENTATION, NO EXECUTION

experiment_stages.name: Independent Corpus Selection
experiment_stages.dataset: NEW PDFs with table-heavy content (NOT the frozen 4 independent PDFs used for IS-01/IS-02 evaluation)
experiment_stages.independence: MUST BE INDEPENDENT — zero references in any P7 artifact; not used in IS-11 development
experiment_stages.purpose: Provide table-containing pages for IS-11 evaluation
experiment_stages.notes: Candidate sources: (1) 3 partially-contaminated PDFs (arxiv_2310, arxiv_2401, qbio_cell) — metadata contamination only, no IS-11 ever computed; CONDITIONALLY USABLE with provenance tracking. (2) New external PDFs with diverse table styles. Need ≥30 TABLE_CELL cases for statistical power.

experiment_stages.name: Frozen P1-P6 Processing
experiment_stages.dataset: Selected independent PDFs from Stage A
experiment_stages.purpose: Extract observations, spans, geometry using frozen pipeline
experiment_stages.features_visible: P1 observations, P2 geometry, P3 style, P4 spans (AMBIGUOUS only), P5 reading order, P6 regions (DENSE/SPARSE)
experiment_stages.notes: P1-P6 does NOT detect tables. DENSE_REGION is a weak proxy. table_line_detector.py exists but is NOT in pipeline.

experiment_stages.name: Geometric Candidate Universe
experiment_stages.purpose: Generate candidate boundary pairs using frozen P4 AMBIGUOUS criteria
experiment_stages.features_visible: Geometry only (gap, dy, w_a, w_b, same_style, line_obs)
experiment_stages.notes: Same AMBIGUOUS criteria as IS-01/IS-02 experiment: 8<gap≤50, same_style, line_obs≤15, w_b≥15

experiment_stages.name: Blind Semantic GT Collection
experiment_stages.dataset: Sampled cases from Stage C (stratified by geometry + TABLE_CELL presence)
experiment_stages.independence: MAINTAINED — reviewers blind to IS-11, IS-01, IS-02, geometry, machine prediction
experiment_stages.purpose: Collect Level 2 Semantic GT (dual reviewer + adjudication)
experiment_stages.features_visible: case_id, page, text_a, text_b, page_context ONLY
experiment_stages.human_gt: COLLECTED AND FROZEN before machine evaluation
experiment_stages.notes: Reviewers see same blind package as IS-01/IS-02 experiment. No IS features, no geometry, no machine output. Must include ≥30 TABLE_CELL cases.

experiment_stages.name: Evaluation Set Freeze
experiment_stages.purpose: Freeze evaluation set before any machine evaluation
experiment_stages.notes: Provenance audit required (same 9-point audit as IS-01/IS-02 experiment)

experiment_stages.name: Baseline A+B Machine Evaluation
experiment_stages.features_visible: Baseline A: geometry only (P4 DETERMINISTIC + AMBIGUOUS); Baseline B: geometry + IS-01 + IS-02 (frozen §9.3 protocol)
experiment_stages.notes: Baseline B should reproduce IS-01/IS-02 results on new corpus. Expected: TABLE_CELL FP pattern continues if table-heavy PDFs included.

experiment_stages.name: IS-11 Observation
experiment_stages.purpose: Compute IS-11 TABLE_CELL_CONTEXT observation using FROZEN IS-11 definition
experiment_stages.features_visible: IS-11 observation (table_region, cell_membership, same_cell/different_cell) + Baseline B features
experiment_stages.freeze_status: IS-11 spec MUST be frozen BEFORE this stage
experiment_stages.notes: IS-11 definition must be frozen before Stage G. IS-11 may use table_line_detector.py output OR new table detection method — but definition is frozen once set.

experiment_stages.name: Decision Comparison
experiment_stages.purpose: Compare Baseline A vs Baseline B vs Experimental (IS-11) decisions against frozen GT
experiment_stages.human_gt: FROZEN (used for evaluation only, not for tuning)
experiment_stages.notes: Compute ΔPrecision, ΔRecall, ΔCoverage, ΔAbstention, ΔFPR, ΔShrinkage. Pre-registered gates checked.

baselines.name: Geometry Only
baselines.features: P4 DETERMINISTIC_MERGE + DETERMINISTIC_BLOCK + AMBIGUOUS (no IS features)
baselines.expected_behavior: AMBIGUOUS cases → all INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (no IS features to decide)
baselines.purpose: Establish floor — what happens with zero IS features

baselines.name: Geometry + IS-01 + IS-02
baselines.expected_behavior: Expected to reproduce TABLE_CELL FP pattern if table-heavy PDFs included; Precision likely low on TABLE_CELL subset
baselines.purpose: Establish IS-01/IS-02 baseline for incremental comparison

baselines.name: Geometry + IS-01 + IS-02 + IS-11
baselines.expected_behavior: HYPOTHESIS: IS-11 enables correct KEEP_SEPARATE for TABLE_CELL pairs that IS-01+IS-02 would MERGE
baselines.purpose: Measure incremental information gain from IS-11

one_new_is_at_a_time.principle: IS-11 ONLY in first experiment. IS-12, IS-14, IS-10 NOT included.
one_new_is_at_a_time.reason: Cannot attribute improvement to IS-11 if multiple new sources added simultaneously
one_new_is_at_a_time.is_12_excluded: ROW_COLUMN_POSITION — co-occurs with IS-11, test in separate experiment after IS-11 validated
one_new_is_at_a_time.is_14_excluded: DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE_ROLE — defer until IS-11 experiment completed
one_new_is_at_a_time.is_10_excluded: SENTENCE_BOUNDARY — HUMAN_OWNED (Category C), never implementable as deterministic rule

pre_registered_gates.name: Independent Data
pre_registered_gates.condition: ≥30 TABLE_CELL cases from independent PDFs (not from frozen 69-case set)

pre_registered_gates.name: IS-11 Specification Freeze
pre_registered_gates.condition: IS-11 definition frozen before GT collection

pre_registered_gates.name: No Leakage
pre_registered_gates.condition: Provenance audit: IS-11 spec not derived from GT; GT not influenced by IS-11

pre_registered_gates.name: Cross-Document Coverage
pre_registered_gates.condition: IS-11 tested on ≥2 documents with tables

pre_registered_gates.name: Abstention Safety
pre_registered_gates.condition: No new FP from cases that were previously correct abstention

pre_registered_gates.name: Boundary Shrinkage
pre_registered_gates.condition: Validated shrinkage > 0 (IS-11 enables correct deterministic decisions that IS-01+IS-02 could not make)
